blocks.text: Cloverdale homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Cloverdale, October 2026. Detached houses: 158 listed at month end and 26 sold in October, a sales ratio of 16% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 105 listed at month end and 11 sold in October, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 126 sold over 5 months against an average of 163.4 listed, about 6.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 29 sold. Condos and townhomes: 80 sold over 5 months against an average of 104.4 listed, about 6.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 19 sold.

faq.q: Is Cloverdale its own city, or part of Surrey?
faq.a: Part of Surrey — Cloverdale is one of the seven communities on the City of Surrey's Our Communities page, described by the City as its historic centre and its third largest community, with Langley to the east and Guildford and Fleetwood to the north.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Cloverdale?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 158 houses listed with 26 sold in the month and 105 condos and townhomes listed with 11 sold in the month in Cloverdale. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Cloverdale a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 16%, a balanced market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 10%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Cloverdale?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
